question: For sodium chlorate droplets at RH of about 33% and 28 C, by how many percentage points did the share of coffee-ring deposits change when the magnetic field was applied?
expect: +40 points: 40.0% zero field to 80% with the field (Table 3)
rendered:
At RH ≈ 33% and T = 28 °C, in the absence of a magnetic field, 40.0% of the deposits were coffee-ring structures. 
In the presence of a magnetic field of (290 ± 5) mT, 37.5% of the deposits were coffee-ring structures.
The share of coffee-ring deposits decreased by 2.5 percentage points.
